articles.summary: National CineMedia (NASDAQ:NCMI) (“NCM”), the largest cinema advertising platform in the US, today announced Bernadette McCabe as Vice President, Exhibitor Relations for NCM and Spotlight, effective May 5, 2026. McCabe will succeed Jennifer Lupo, who will retire from the Company on May 4, 2026. McCabe and Lupo will continue to work closely to ensure a seamless transition for the Company’s partners.
articles.title: National CineMedia Names Bernadette McCabe Vice President, Exhibitor Relations

articles.summary: National CineMedia (NASDAQ: NCMI) (NCM), the largest cinema advertising platform in the US, and the U.S. Representative of the Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity, today announced the five winning teams of the 2026 U.S. Young Lions competition. The winning teams were named and honored by NCM on April 22, 2026, at the TEAM USA Winners Announcement event, with all finalist teams in attendance.
articles.title: National CineMedia Announces 2026 U.S. Young Lions Winners
